values: 画出法阵，禁止其中的敌人恢复生命值并对其造成真实伤害。
Faramor summons a magic circle to deal true damage to enemies within and prevents them from recovering HP.
消耗250 − 10点能量，以当前目标为中心画出半径1格的法阵，形成时对区域内敌人造成210% + 20% ATK真实伤害。法阵存在期间，自身每秒消耗120点能量，法阵内所有敌人无法回复生命，每0.5秒受到35% ATK加上目标已损失生命值20%的真实伤害。额外伤害部分不超过自身攻击力的240%。若持续1秒内法阵中无敌人，本技能会提前结束。

Faramor consumes 250 − 10 Energy to summon a 1-tile magic circle, centered on his current target, dealing 210% + 20% ATK true damage to enemies caught inside. While the circle is active, he consumes 120 Energy per second to maintain it. Enemies within the circle cannot heal; every 0.5s, they take 35% ATK true damage, plus extra true damage equal to 20% of their lost HP. The extra true damage cannot exceed 240% of Faramor's ATK. If no enemies remain in the circle for 1s, the skill ends immediately.
法阵形成时伤害提升至220% + 20% ATK，后续的持续伤害提升至40% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when summoning the magic circle to 220% + 20% ATK and the subsequent damage to 40% ATK per hit.
法阵形成时伤害提升至230% + 20% ATK，后续的持续伤害提升至45% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when summoning the magic circle to 230% + 20% ATK and the subsequent damage to 45% ATK per hit.
法阵形成时伤害提升至240% + 20% ATK，后续的持续伤害提升至50% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when summoning the magic circle to 240% + 20% ATK and the subsequent damage to 50% ATK per hit.
法阵形成时伤害提升至250% + 20% ATK，后续的持续伤害提升至55% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt when summoning the magic circle to 250% + 20% ATK and the subsequent damage to 55% ATK per hit.
使用十字剑祈祷，使自身获得护盾并对敌人造成伤害。
Faramor prays, imbuing his weapon with sacred power, gaining a shield while dealing damage to his current target.
将十字剑放在胸前祈祷，自身获得可抵御200% + 20% ATK伤害的护盾，持续6秒，并为剑附上圣洁的力量，对目标造成250% + 25% ATK伤害。若释放该技能时，自身带有友军施加的非永久属性提升效果，伤害类型变为真实伤害。

Faramor prays to imbue his weapon with sacred power, gaining a shield that can absorb 200% + 20% ATK damage while dealing 250% + 25% ATK damage to his current target. The shield lasts for 6s. If Faramor has an active non-permanent stat boost from his allies when using this skill, it instead deals true damage.
对目标造成的伤害提升至260% + 25% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to the target to 260% + 25% ATK.
对目标造成的伤害提升至270% + 25% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to the target to 270% + 25% ATK.
对目标造成的伤害提升至280% + 25% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to the target to 280% + 25% ATK.
使用符器庇护自身和一名友军，获得攻击力提升和对周围一格的眩晕效果。
Faramor blesses an ally, increasing the ATK of both himself and the ally while stunning nearby enemies within 1 tile of each.
备战时，选择1格范围内的一名友方英雄缔约圣言（优先选择更靠近身后的友军）。主动释放时，为自身和该英雄提升12% + 1.5%攻击力，持续10秒，持续时间结束后会再次释放此效果。在持续时间内，每3秒对增益持有者1格范围内的敌人造成0.5秒眩晕和100% ATK伤害。

Passive. During battle preparation, Faramor can bless an adjacent allied hero, prioritizing those placed behind him.
Active. Faramor increases ATK by 12% + 1.5% for 10s for both himself and the hero he blesses, automatically reapplying the buff when it expires. Every 3s while the buff is active, Faramor also deals 100% ATK damage to enemies within 1 tile of both himself and the blessed hero, stunning the affected enemies for 0.5s.
为自身和友军提升的攻击力提升至13% + 1.5%。
Faramor increases the ATK of himself and the blessed allied hero by 13% + 1.5%.
为自身和友军提升的攻击力提升至14% + 1.5%。
Faramor increases the ATK of himself and the blessed allied hero by 14% + 1.5%.
为自身和友军提升的攻击力提升至15% + 1.5%。
Faramor increases the ATK of himself and the blessed allied hero by 15% + 1.5%.
战斗中，自身提高12点急速。
战斗中，自身提高16点急速。
战斗中，自身提高20点急速。
法阵存在时，自身获得增强，法阵内敌人受到额外的真实伤害。
While active, the magic circle enhances Faramor's abilities and allows allies to deal extra true damage to enemies inside.
当法阵存在时，使用“圣佑之刃”替换普攻，获得的护盾值不超过600% ATK。每次友军对法阵内敌人造成伤害时，将附带友军攻击力75%的真实伤害，每名友军1秒内最多触发1次附加伤害。

Faramor replaces his normal attacks with Glory's Embrace while his magic circle is active, but the shield value he gains from Glory's Embrace is capped at 600% ATK. The magic circle also weakens the enemies within it, allowing allies to deal extra true damage equal to 75% of their ATK. Each ally can only trigger the extra damage once every 1s.
附带的真实伤害提升至友军攻击力的80%。
Increases the extra true damage dealt by allies to 80% of their ATK.
每场战斗一次，法阵内敌人被击败时，使自身获得10%的攻击力，并使法阵永久强化，半径扩大到2格。
When an enemy is defeated within the magic circle, grants Faramor 10% ATK and expands the circle's radius to 2 tiles. This effect can only trigger once per battle.
附带的真实伤害提升至友军攻击力的85%。
Increases the extra true damage dealt by allies to 85% of their ATK.
降低法阵内敌人复活后的受愈。
Faramor reduces the Vitality of enemies who revive within his magic circle.
若法阵内的敌人在生命值归零后再次复活，则使其受愈下降50点。
If an enemy revives within Faramor's magic circle after their HP drops to 0, Faramor will reduce their Vitality by 50.
